# 工作流爪（Workflow Claw） / Workflow Claw

> 功能 / Feature

查看由工作流部署的成员 Claw 群，并从独立画廊创建、进入各成员工作区。

Inspect the cohort of workflow-deployed member Claws and open or create each member workspace from a dedicated gallery.

## 完整功能清单 / Everything included

- **Agent 可定位入口，需交互完成 / Agent opens; interaction required** · 浏览工作流成员 Claw 画廊并区分普通助手
  - Browse the workflow member Claw gallery, isolated from plain assistants
- **Agent 可定位入口，需交互完成 / Agent opens; interaction required** · 创建并进入工作流成员工作区
  - Create and open workflow member workspaces

## 怎么用 / How to use it

1. 在导航栏打开“工作流爪”场景
   Open the Workflow Claw scene from the navigation bar
2. 浏览成员画廊，或创建并进入成员工作区
   Browse the member gallery, or create and open a member workspace
